mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits multiple CYP450 enzymes (CYP2D6, CYP3A4) which metabolize rivastigmine, potentially increasing rivastigmine exposure and adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased rivastigmine adverse effects (nausea, vomiting, dizziness, syncope); consider rivastigmine dose reduction if toxicity occurs; ensure adequate hepatic function assessment.
